Eight-column portico, broad stair, pediment, low green-copper roof and 4 m entry section replace the rejected Art Deco/classical atlas mismatch.
Five construction-depth stone arches, framed set-back shop wall, ochre upper floors and a low textured hip roof reproduce the main hierarchy.
The existing exact-style atlas combines well with five 2.8 m loading recesses, a rusticated base and a textured membrane roof.
